description: Model input schema for CreditLens, built from the training split in notebooks/03_eda_feature_engineering.ipynb

features.name: NoEmp
features.label: Number of employees
features.help: Head count of the business at application.

features.name: CreateJob
features.label: Jobs to be created
features.help: New jobs the business expects the loan to create.

features.name: RetainedJob
features.label: Jobs retained
features.help: Existing jobs the loan is expected to keep.

features.name: Portion
features.label: Guaranteed share
features.help: Share of the loan covered by the government guarantee (0 to 1).

features.name: TermYears
features.label: Term (years)
features.help: Scheduled loan term in years.

features.name: LogDisbursement
features.label: Log of disbursed amount
features.help: Natural log of (1 + amount disbursed in USD).

features.name: LoanPerEmployee
features.label: Loan per employee (USD)
features.help: Disbursed amount divided by the number of employees (at least 1).

features.name: JobsPerDollar
features.label: Jobs per USD 100,000
features.help: Created plus retained jobs per USD 100,000 disbursed.

features.name: DisbursedToApprovedRatio
features.label: Disbursed to approved ratio
features.help: Amount disbursed divided by the gross amount approved.

features.name: ApprovalYear
features.label: Approval year
features.help: Calendar year in which the guarantee was approved.

features.name: ApprovalMonth
features.label: Approval month
features.help: Calendar month of approval (1 to 12).

features.name: DisbursementLagDays
features.label: Days from approval to disbursement
features.help: Days between approval and disbursement; 0 when the disbursement date is not known.

features.name: RealEstate
features.label: Real-estate term (20 years or more)
features.help: 1 if the term is 240 months or more, which normally means the loan is secured on property.

features.name: Recession
features.label: Active during the 2007-2009 recession
features.help: 1 if the scheduled life of the loan overlaps December 2007 to June 2009.

features.name: NewBusiness
features.label: New business
features.help: 1 if the business is two years old or less.

features.name: IsFranchise
features.label: Franchise
features.help: 1 if the business operates under a franchise agreement.

features.name: SameStateBank
features.label: Lender in the same state
features.help: 1 if the lending bank is in the borrower's state.

features.name: DisbursementDateMissing
features.label: Disbursement date unknown
features.help: 1 if no disbursement date was recorded and the approval date was used instead.

features.name: Sector
features.label: Industry sector
features.help: NAICS sector of the business; Unknown when no industry code was recorded.
allowed: Administrative and support and waste management
Real estate and rental and leasing
Mining, quarrying, and oil and gas extraction

features.name: RevLineCr
features.label: Revolving line of credit
features.help: Y, N, T (an undocumented code in the source data that behaves differently from Y) or Unknown.

features.name: LowDoc
features.label: LowDoc programme
features.help: Y if the loan used the one-page low-documentation application.

features.name: UrbanRural
features.label: Urban or rural
features.help: Location type of the business; Unknown for loans where it was not recorded.

features.name: NewExist
features.label: Business age group
features.help: Existing (more than two years), New (two years or less) or Unknown.

features.name: State
features.label: Borrower state
features.help: Two-letter US state code of the business.

features.name: BankState
features.label: Bank state
features.help: Two-letter state code of the lending bank.

features.name: Bank
features.label: Lending bank
features.help: Name of the lending bank; encoded as BankSize and BankDefaultRate inside the model.

features.note: Banks not in this list are encoded with the overall training default rate.

features.name: BankSize
features.label: Bank size (loans in training data)
features.help: Number of training loans made by the same bank; 0 for a bank not seen in training.

features.name: BankDefaultRate
features.label: Bank historical default rate
features.help: Smoothed default rate of the bank's training loans; the overall rate for a new bank.

raw_form_fields.name: Term
raw_form_fields.label: Term (months)
raw_form_fields.help: Scheduled term of the loan in months.

raw_form_fields.name: NoEmp
raw_form_fields.label: Number of employees
raw_form_fields.help: Head count of the business at application.

raw_form_fields.name: CreateJob
raw_form_fields.label: Jobs to be created
raw_form_fields.help: New jobs the business expects the loan to create.

raw_form_fields.name: RetainedJob
raw_form_fields.label: Jobs retained
raw_form_fields.help: Existing jobs the loan is expected to keep.

raw_form_fields.name: DisbursementGross
raw_form_fields.label: Amount disbursed (USD)
raw_form_fields.help: Amount paid out to the borrower.

raw_form_fields.name: GrAppv
raw_form_fields.label: Gross amount approved (USD)
raw_form_fields.help: Loan amount approved by the bank.

raw_form_fields.name: SBA_Appv
raw_form_fields.label: Guaranteed amount (USD)
raw_form_fields.help: Part of the approved amount covered by the guarantee; cannot exceed the approved amount.

raw_form_fields.name: FranchiseCode
raw_form_fields.label: Franchise code
raw_form_fields.help: 0 or 1 means no franchise; any other value is a franchise code.

raw_form_fields.name: DisbursementDate
raw_form_fields.label: Disbursement date
raw_form_fields.help: Disbursement date may be left empty; the approval date is then used.
